info.title: Cleared API
info.description: Steps 1 to 3 of a deal: signing in, deals, brief to checklist, the invite and the brand's link, change requests, agreeing and the holds. A creator's session and a brand's are HttpOnly cookies set by this API. Every error has one shape: a code and, where useful, the field it is about.

404.description: No such post, or it is not this creator's

409.description: The post takes no draft now: not held, released, approved, or a check is running

422.description: The file cannot be checked: unreadable, not an MP4 or MOV, or too long (with its length and the cap)

503.description: This service is not set up to store drafts

get.summary: Sign in with Google: the browser is sent here, on to Google, and back into the app (DS-FR-01)

302.description: To Google; afterwards to `next`, /deals or /welcome, or to /sign-in?problem=… if it did not work

302.description: To Google; afterwards to `next` or /deals with `connected=youtube`, or `connect=failed`, `declined` or `no_channel`
